Condition : 1 - APPROVE the following materials pursuant to Condition B4:

Main brick: 	New buff malt-coloured Milton Hall Kentish stock brick in stretcher bond. 

Detail brick:	New buff malt-coloured Milton Hall Kentish stock brick in stretcher bond.  Ready-made soldier courses with the appropriately angled bricks in matching buff malt-coloured bricks.

Windows:  	In terms of the window schedule Ref 13857/data/svhed RevB:  11/08/2005.  

Dormer window:	Timber construction with timber round top; lead cladding.

Flat roofs:	      Single ply membrane (Ecofin Delta SP).

Pitched roof:	New slate grey natural slates.

Window cills and copings:	Buff (oatmeal-coloured) "Bath" imitation stone made from concrete.
description: Following approval for partial demolition and alteration to existing buildings.  Erection of two storeys over the ground floor retail unit to provide additional retail accommodation and 2 bedroom flat on first floor plus two 2-bedroom flats on second floor at rear of the site (fronting Dolman Road), erection of attached part 3 and part 4 storey building to provide 1 x two-bedroom,  live/work unit, 1 x one bedroom flat and 4 x two bedroom flats - details submitted pursuant to Condition 2 (materials) of approved planning permission ref 00248/370-372/P11 dated 13/09/2004.
